description: Combine status tracking across government processes.
notes: Kit fallback at ../kit-fallback-w9.js; 'today' fixed to 2026-10-03 for deterministic demo

notes.note: One timeline for passports, licenses, and permits with predicted completion dates is calming and useful. But it's a checklist with push alerts — $4/mo for anxiety reduction has terrible retention once the passport arrives. The moving-company white-label is the only revenue-shaped idea, and it's small.
Process cards open detail timelines; zero errors.

notes.change: Hero gained 'Copy status summary' — one click copies the merged predicted-completion summary for all processes (the natural calm-checklist share action). Add-to-board button got data-core.
